message.content:
SPRINT 6b — InkOS Analytics Page: FINAL Production-Readiness Gate. Project: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS

Sprints 1-6a COMPLETE. Plan: /Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/anaystics-page-lets-deep-fizzy-turtle.md

This is the LAST gate before the analytics page is locked. You are the closer.

## What was shipped across Sprints 1-6a

**Foundation (Sprint 1):**
- Layout renamed "Reports" → "Analytics" at `app/(app)/reports/layout.tsx`
- `lib/analytics/range.ts` — `parseRange`, `priorRange`, `rangeDays`, `pickGroupBy`
- `lib/csv-export.ts` — papaparse wrapper
- `hooks/use-export-csv.ts` + `components/reports/AnalyticsExportProvider.tsx`
- `components/reports/AnalyticsToolbar.tsx` — DateRangePicker + Compare toggle + Export CSV
- All 6 `app/api/reports/*/route.ts` accept from/to/compare, return `{ current, prior? }`
- All 6 `components/reports/*ReportClient.tsx` URL-keyed via `useSearchParams`
- `lib/utils.ts` — `formatPercent`, `computeDelta` added; `formatCurrency` 2-decimal fix

**P0 Bug Fixes (Sprint 2):**
- `components/reports/charts/BookingsHeatmap.tsx` — hours 10-22, brand-correct color-mix oklch ramp
- `components/reports/charts/StatusBreakdownBar.tsx` — reconciles all 7 booking statuses
- Bookings 6→3 KPI cards
- Low stock single source unified between `/api/reports/inventory` and `/api/inventory/stock-alerts`
- `tests/unit/reports/bookings-aggregation.test.ts`

**KPI Cleanup + Deltas (Sprint 3):**
- Revenue 5→4 KPI cards (Tips folded), line/bar mode toggle, "Closed" tooltip on $0
- Clients 6→4 KPI cards, varied icons, deltas
- `RechartsAreaChart` + `RechartsBarChart` accept `priorData/priorLabel` for dashed prior overlay
- Real deltas wired across every KPI card with compare on
- No-show pill: Rust filled >10%, Stone outline otherwise (in ArtistsReportClient)
- AI Monthly Cost: empty state when n<2

**Artist Drill-Down (Sprint 4):**
- `app/api/reports/artists/[id]/route.ts` — per-artist detail
- `components/reports/ArtistLeaderboardTable.tsx` — TanStack Table sortable
- `components/reports/ArtistDrillDownDrawer.tsx` — Sheet drawer with `?artist=<id>` deep link
- `lib/types/analytics.ts` — shared types

**Clients/Bookings/Inventory Adds (Sprint 5):**
- `components/reports/charts/CohortHeatmap.tsx`
- `components/reports/charts/LtvHistogram.tsx`
- `components/reports/charts/NewClientsLine.tsx`
- `components/reports/charts/StockValueTrend.tsx`
- Bookings: per-service revenue + avg ticket + no-show rate columns; walk-in vs booked split
- Clients API: cohort retention, LTV distribution, new-clients-by-month

**COGS Honest State + E2E (Sprint 6a):**
- COGS card shows `—` + "Awaiting consumption logs" when `inventory_movements` empty
- Top Consumed Items shows EmptyState `coming-soon`
- `docs/inventory-movements-pipeline.md` design spec
- `tests/e2e/analytics.spec.ts` Playwright suite (16 tests)
- `requireFeatureRpc('analytics')` added to all 6 API routes
- Server-side feature gate in layout
- Brand audit clean in analytics scope

## Sprint 6b Goal — YOUR JOB
Run the production-readiness gate. Find every issue still in scope and either fix or escalate. Block if not ready.

## Constraints (mandatory load)
- /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/CLAUDE.md sections 4 (Brand), 5 (UI), 7 (Architecture), 8 (Forbidden), 9 (Antipatterns)
- ~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/executable-validation-gates.md (your validation contract)
- ~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/saas-ia-separation.md
- Brand: ONLY Bone/Onyx/Stone/Rust. Tabular-nums. Custom shadow tokens only.

## Audit scope
Files in scope (just analytics work — DO NOT review pre-existing code outside this scope):
- `app/(app)/reports/**`
- `app/api/reports/**`
- `components/reports/**`
- `components/reports/charts/**`
- `lib/analytics/range.ts`
- `lib/csv-export.ts`
- `hooks/use-export-csv.ts`
- `lib/types/analytics.ts`
- `tests/unit/reports/**`
- `tests/e2e/analytics.spec.ts`
- `docs/inventory-movements-pipeline.md`
- Modifications in `lib/utils.ts` (`formatPercent`, `computeDelta`, `formatCurrency` change)

## Tasks (execute in order)

### 1. Static analysis pass
Run executable validation gates:
```bash
cd "/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS"
pnpm typecheck 2>&1 | head -100
pnpm lint 2>&1 | head -100
pnpm test 2>&1 | tail -30
```

For typecheck/lint: only flag errors in analytics-scope files. Pre-existing errors elsewhere (flash-events, payroll, messaging, etc.) are out-of-scope.

For tests: identify pre-existing failures (booking-patch.test.ts) vs any new analytics regressions.

### 2. Brand discipline grep
```bash
# Hex literals outside globals.css
rg '#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}\b' components/reports/ app/api/reports/ app/(app)/reports/ lib/analytics/ lib/csv-export.ts hooks/use-export-csv.ts lib/types/analytics.ts

# Default Tailwind shadows in scope
rg '\bshadow-(sm|md|lg|xl|2xl)\b' components/reports/ app/(app)/reports/

# any
rg ': any\b|<any>|as any\b' components/reports/ app/api/reports/ app/(app)/reports/ lib/analytics/ lib/csv-export.ts hooks/use-export-csv.ts lib/types/analytics.ts

# console
rg 'console\.(log|warn|error|info|debug)' components/reports/ app/api/reports/ app/(app)/reports/ lib/analytics/ hooks/use-export-csv.ts

# @ts-ignore / @ts-expect-error
rg '@ts-(ignore|expect-error)' components/reports/ app/api/reports/ app/(app)/reports/ lib/analytics/ lib/csv-export.ts hooks/use-export-csv.ts

# raw white/black hex
rg '#FFFFFF|#000000|#fff|#000\b' components/reports/ app/(app)/reports/

# tailwind.config
ls -la "/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/tailwind.config"* 2>&1 || echo "OK: no tailwind.config"
```

Fix anything found in scope. Escalate if a fix would touch out-of-scope files.

### 3. Security + correctness audit (manual review of each route)
Read each `app/api/reports/*/route.ts` and verify:
- [ ] `getAuthenticatedUser` called and 401 on null
- [ ] Role check `['owner', 'admin'].includes(auth.role)` and 403 on fail
- [ ] `requireFeatureRpc(supabase, studioId, 'analytics')` called — Sprint 6a added this
- [ ] `authedRatelimit.limit` called and 429 on fail
- [ ] Zod `safeParse` on query params, 400 on fail
- [ ] All Supabase queries `.eq('studio_id', auth.studioId)` — no cross-tenant leak
- [ ] No raw SQL injection vectors
- [ ] `try/catch` with `logger.error` (not `console.*`)
- [ ] No `service-role` client used outside webhook handlers (per CLAUDE.md)

Read `app/(app)/reports/layout.tsx` and verify:
- [ ] Async server component
- [ ] Server-side feature gate executes before children render

Read `components/reports/AnalyticsToolbar.tsx` and verify:
- [ ] `'use client'`
- [ ] `router.replace` not `router.push` (per Sprint 1 decision)
- [ ] No state leak across tab switches

Read `components/reports/ArtistDrillDownDrawer.tsx` and verify:
- [ ] ESC closes drawer (Sheet handles native)
- [ ] URL `?artist=` cleared on close
- [ ] Focus trap inside drawer when open
- [ ] React Query key includes artistId + range + compare

### 4. Accessibility audit
Read each chart component and verify:
- [ ] BookingsHeatmap: `role="grid"`, `role="row"`, cell ARIA labels include day + hour + count
- [ ] CohortHeatmap: same grid roles, labels include cohort + N+ index + percent
- [ ] LtvHistogram: chart has `role="img" aria-label` summarizing distribution
- [ ] StatusBreakdownBar: `role="img" aria-label` summarizing breakdown
- [ ] KpiCard: existing component — verify delta has accessible text not just color
- [ ] No-show pill: when Rust filled, accessible name still includes the percentage

Verify focus order on /reports/artists: tab → toolbar → tab nav → table headers → first row → drawer (when open) — should be logical.

### 5. Type strictness final pass
Re-grep:
```bash
rg ': any\b|<any>|as any\b' components/reports/ app/api/reports/ lib/analytics/ lib/csv-export.ts hooks/use-export-csv.ts lib/types/analytics.ts
```

Verify `lib/types/analytics.ts` is the single source of truth — no inline duplicates of `ArtistRow`, `ClientsBlock`, etc. in clients or routes that drift.

### 6. Validation gate per executable-validation-gates.md
Run the runnable bash gates from `~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/executable-validation-gates.md` for the Sage role. Report PASS/FAIL per gate.

### 7. Find any remaining audit-PDF items not addressed
Re-read the audit checklist in the plan file. Verify every item:
- Cut: Revenue-by-Period bar (✓ replaced with mode toggle), Person-icons on Clients (varied — Sprint 3 decision; verify acceptable)
- Move: Export CSV global (✓ Sprint 1)
- Fix 14: page rename, breadcrumb, heatmap, services, low stock, COGS, 5→4 Revenue KPIs, deltas, $0 closed tooltip, auto-scale Y, 6→3 Bookings KPIs, math reconcile, stubby bars (auto group_by), heatmap hours, 6→4 Clients KPIs, no-show pill, stock decimals, AI single bar, sort columns
- Add 14: date range, compare toggle, export CSV global, avg session $, sort columns, drill-down, new clients line, cohort heatmap, LTV histo, status bar, per-service detail, walk-in/booked, stock value trend, top consumed (empty state)

Make a "MISSED" list. If anything legitimately missed, fix it now if trivial; otherwise escalate.

### 8. FINAL VERDICT
Output one of:
- **APPROVED FOR LOCK** — green light, every gate passed
- **APPROVED WITH FOLLOW-UPS** — small non-blocking items filed for next cycle
- **BLOCKED** — critical issue found, must fix before lock

## Report format
Caveman OK. Structure:

1. **Static analysis results** — typecheck/lint/test pass-fail
2. **Brand audit results** — grep findings + fixes
3. **Security/correctness findings** — list per route with severity (P0/P1/P2)
4. **A11y findings**
5. **Type strictness findings**
6. **Audit-PDF coverage check** — anything missed
7. **Files modified by Sage** (if any fixes applied)
8. **VERDICT** — APPROVED / APPROVED-WITH-FOLLOW-UPS / BLOCKED with reasoning
